def amend_owned_tip(root, expected_head, paths, result_rel):
    require(git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD") == expected_head, "AMEND_HEAD_CHANGED")
    require(not git(root, "for-each-ref", "--contains=" + expected_head, "--format=%(refname)", "refs/remotes"),
            "RESULT_COMMIT_IS_PUBLISHED")
    require(set(git(root, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", expected_head).splitlines()) == set(paths),
            "AMEND_ORIGINAL_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
    parent = git(root, "rev-parse", expected_head + "^")
    unrelated = set(git(root, "diff", "--cached", "--name-only").splitlines()) - {result_rel}
    before = {p: subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", ":" + p], cwd=root) for p in unrelated}
    subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "--amend", "--only", "-m",
                    "Seal B649 K20 V7 destroy3 result with bounded terminal recount", "--", result_rel], cwd=root, check=True)
    commit = git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
    require(git(root, "rev-parse", commit + "^") == parent, "AMEND_PARENT_CHANGED")
    require(set(git(root, "diff-tree", "--no-commit-id", "--name-only", "-r", commit).splitlines()) == set(paths),
            "AMEND_COMMIT_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
    for p, value in before.items():
        require(subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", ":" + p], cwd=root) == value, "UNRELATED_INDEX_CHANGED")
    return commit, parent
